summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of admin authentication migration from localStorage JWT to httpOnly cookie session, plus public SEO features. All critical authentication flows verified working correctly in production environment.
passed_tests: ✅ Public RERA page renders with RERA table and FAQ accordion
✅ FAQPage JSON-LD schema present in /rera page HTML
✅ Admin login with correct credentials (username + password) works and redirects to /admin dashboard
✅ httpOnly cookie 'admin_token' is set with correct attributes (httpOnly=True, secure=True, sameSite=None)
✅ NO auth tokens stored in localStorage (verified empty localStorage)
✅ Session persists after full page reload without localStorage token
✅ Authenticated navigation to /admin/projects works (cookie-based API calls successful)
✅ Admin logout clears 'admin_token' cookie and redirects to /admin/login
✅ Protected routes redirect to /admin/login when not authenticated
✅ Wrong password shows error message 'Invalid username or password' and does NOT authenticate
